ei.subject: 수능특강Light 영어
ei.title: Acting in Haste Comes at a High Cost

fullPassage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.

questions.passage: The desire to (A)[rush / pause] into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people (B)[overestimate / underestimate] what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking (C)[advantage / notice] of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① rush - overestimate - advantage: 무언가에 '서두르며', 단기간 성과를 '과대평가'하고, 남들이 '이용'할 위험이 있다는 원문.
❌ ② pause - overestimate - advantage: '멈추다'는 성급함의 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ rush - underestimate - advantage: '과소평가'는 원문의 overestimate와 반대.
❌ ④ rush - overestimate - notice: take notice of(주목하다)는 take advantage of(이용하다)와 의미가 다름.
det.tip: rush into(~에 서두르다). overestimate(과대평가) ↔ underestimate(과소평가). take advantage of(이용하다).

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a (A)[lack / abundance] of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to (B)[relieve / increase] pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to (C)[overpaying / saving] for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ lack - relieve - overpaying: 비전의 '부족'을 보여주고, 고통을 '덜려는' 시도이며, 자산에 '과다 지불'하게 된다는 원문.
❌ ① abundance - relieve - overpaying: '풍부함'은 부족의 반대.
❌ ② lack - increase - overpaying: '늘리다'는 고통을 덜려는 맥락과 반대.
❌ ④ lack - relieve - saving: '절약'은 과다 지불과 반대.
det.tip: lack(부족) ↔ abundance(풍부). relieve(덜다) ↔ increase(늘리다). overpay(과다 지불) ↔ save(절약).

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be (A)[driven / calmed] by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and (B)[underestimate / overestimate] what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you (C)[risk / ensure] others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② driven - underestimate - risk: 성급함이 두려움에 의해 '추동'되고, 장기 성과를 '과소평가'하며, 남에게 이용당할 '위험'이 있다는 원문.
❌ ① calmed - underestimate - risk: '진정된'은 두려움에 의해 추동된다는 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ driven - overestimate - risk: 장기 성과를 또 '과대평가'하면 앞의 overestimate와 중복되어 대비 구조가 깨짐.
❌ ④ driven - underestimate - ensure: '보장하다'는 위험을 무릅쓰는 맥락과 반대.
det.tip: driven by(~에 의해 추동된). overestimate ↔ underestimate 대비 구조. risk + V-ing(~할 위험을 무릅쓰다).

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to ①<u>relieve</u> pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to ②<u>overpaying</u> for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great ③<u>deals</u> out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be ④<u>worse</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① relieve: 고통을 '덜다' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ② overpaying: '과다 지불' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ deals: 좋은 '거래'가 있다 — 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ worse: 원문은 better(더 나은). 다음에 오는 거래가 '더 나쁠' 수 있다는 건 성급함을 경계하는 맥락과 반대.
det.tip: better(더 나은) ↔ worse(더 나쁜). 기회는 계속 온다는 긍정적 메시지.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a ①<u>lack</u> of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people ②<u>underestimate</u> what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you ③<u>risk</u> others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be ④<u>better</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① lack: 비전의 '부족' — 원문 그대로.
✅ ② underestimate: 원문은 overestimate(과대평가하다). 단기간에 달성할 수 있는 것을 '과소평가'한다면 뒤의 underestimate와 대비가 안 됨.
❌ ③ risk: 남에게 이용당할 '위험' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ better: '더 나은' 거래 — 원문 그대로.
det.tip: overestimate(단기) ↔ underestimate(장기) 대비 구조가 핵심.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of ①<u>clarity</u> of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a ②<u>lifetime</u>. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and ③<u>consumables</u>, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you ④<u>seize</u> this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① clarity: 비전의 '명확함' 부족 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ② lifetime: '일생' 동안의 성취 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ consumables: '소모품'에 과다 지불 — 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ seize: 원문은 miss(놓치다). 이 거래를 '잡으면' 다른 것이 온다는 건 놓쳐도 괜찮다는 원문 논리와 반대.
det.tip: miss(놓치다) ↔ seize(잡다). 놓쳐도 다른 기회가 온다는 메시지.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking __________ of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② advantage: take advantage of(이용하다)는 관용 표현. 성급하면 남들이 '이용'할 위험.
❌ ① care: take care of(돌보다)는 이 맥락과 무관.
❌ ③ control: take control of(통제하다)는 의미가 다름.
❌ ④ pride: take pride in(자부심)은 of와 결합 불가.
det.tip: take advantage of = ~을 이용하다. 성급함이 남에게 이용당할 빌미가 됨.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. __________ could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. __________ will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ Impatience: 두 빈칸 모두 '성급함'이 주어. 두려움에 추동되고 과다 지불을 초래한다.
❌ ① Patience: '인내'는 과다 지불을 초래하지 않음.
❌ ② Confidence: '자신감'은 두려움에 추동되지 않음.
❌ ③ Generosity: '관대함'은 맥락과 무관.
det.tip: Impatience(성급함)가 두 문장의 공통 주어.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of __________ of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① clarity: 비전과 가치의 '명확함'이 부족하다는 의미. 서두르면 판단력이 흐려짐.
❌ ② excess: '과잉'은 lack of와 결합하면 비전이 과하게 부족하다는 어색한 의미.
❌ ③ freedom: '자유'의 부족은 비전·가치 맥락과 안 맞음.
❌ ④ memory: '기억'의 부족은 성급함과 무관.
det.tip: lack of clarity = 명확함의 부족. 서두르면 비전과 가치관이 흐려진다.

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. Impatience could be driven by fear, worry or greed, or be an attempt to relieve pain, a desire to look good in front of others, or a fear of missing out, and so on. Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time and underestimate what they can achieve in a lifetime. You have more time than you think. Impatience will lead to overpaying for assets and consumables, and you risk others taking advantage of you. There are great deals out there all the time. If you miss this one, there will be others that come along. They may even be better. In short, acting in haste __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성급한 행동은 높은 대가를 치르게 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② comes at a high cost: 과다 지불·이용당함 등 '높은 대가'가 성급함의 결과라는 본문 논지.
❌ ① guarantees the best possible outcome: '최선의 결과를 보장한다'는 본문과 반대.
❌ ③ is the only way to succeed quickly: '빨리 성공하는 유일한 방법'은 본문 주장과 반대.
❌ ④ shows strong leadership qualities: '강한 리더십'은 본문 맥락과 무관.
det.tip: 본문 전체가 성급함의 부정적 결과를 나열 → '높은 대가'.

ch: is the only way to succeed quickly

"대부분의 사람들은 단기간에 달성할 수 있는 것을 과대평가한다."

det.korean: T — 'Most people overestimate what they can achieve in a short time'와 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ T(참): 본문에 정확히 명시된 내용.
❌ F: 본문 진술과 정확히 일치하므로 F는 부적절.
det.tip: overestimate(과대평가) + short time(단기간).

questions.passage: The desire to rush into something often shows a lack of clarity of vision and values. det.analysis:
✅ F(거짓): 본문은 'lead to overpaying for assets and consumables'로, 절약이 아니라 과다 지불.
❌ T: 절약(saving)이 아닌 과다 지불(overpaying)이므로 T는 부적절.
det.tip: overpaying(과다 지불) ≠ saving(절약).

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 기회는 한 번 놓치면 다시 오지 않는다 — 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 서두름은 비전의 명확함 부족을 보여준다: 'shows a lack of clarity of vision' — 일치.
❌ ② 성급함은 두려움이나 탐욕에 의해 추동될 수 있다: 'driven by fear, worry or greed' — 일치.
✅ ③ 기회는 한 번 놓치면 다시 오지 않는다: 본문은 'there will be others that come along'으로 다른 기회가 온다고 함.
❌ ④ 사람들은 생각보다 더 많은 시간을 가지고 있다: 'You have more time than you think' — 일치.
det.tip: 본문의 핵심 메시지: 기회는 다시 온다. 서두를 필요 없다.

det.analysis:
✅ ② 성급함의 위험성과 인내의 가치: 성급함이 과다 지불·이용당함으로 이어지고, 기회는 계속 온다는 것이 본문 전체.
❌ ① 현대 소비 문화의 장점: 소비 문화 장점은 본문 주제가 아님.
❌ ③ 단기 투자의 효과적인 전략: 투자 전략은 본문과 무관.
❌ ④ 경쟁 사회에서의 빠른 의사결정 기술: 빠른 의사결정을 권장하지 않음.
det.tip: 핵심: 서두르지 마라. 기회는 또 온다.
